decisions.decision: Wire skill.Registry (NOT skill.Loader) as the listing/reload signal source. Loader stays for wizard-commit registration confirmation + chat findSkill + agent construction; Registry is additive for the listing/reload path.
decisions.rationale: Registry already has correct, TESTED fsnotify + per-skill Entry.Version + graceful per-file failure (D5-06 keep-old + D5-08 loadError hook). Re-implementing on Loader would duplicate the Registry AND break Loader.Scan's fail-fast startup contract. Dual startup scan (~1 skill) is negligible.

decisions.decision: Replace time.Now().UnixNano() Entry.Version with a per-process monotonic atomic.Int64 counter (from 1).
decisions.rationale: UnixNano (~1.7e18 > 2^53); reloadOne bumps prev.Version+1, but at 1.7e18 the JS double ULP ≈ 512, so a +1 reload bump is INVISIBLE to the JS polling client — reloads could not be detected. The counter keeps every Version well under 2^53. All existing registry_test.go assertions are RELATIVE (>0, >pinned, ==goodVersion, unchanged-on-failure) so a counter satisfies every one; no test asserts UnixNano shape. Per-process reset is fine because the FE known-version map also resets on page load.

decisions.decision: Surface reload failures via a NEW copy-on-write Registry.failed map (name→err.Error()), overlaid as status:"failed" in the HTTP listing, WITHOUT bumping Entry.Version.
decisions.rationale: T4 (TestRegistry_Reload_ValidationFailure_KeepsOld) + T6 (_SymlinkEscape_Rejected) pin the keep-old contract: on failure the Version AND manifest MUST stay unchanged. Bumping version on failure would break those tests and the keep-old semantic. setFailed on error; clearFailed on next success.

decisions.decision: GET /api/skills response shape changes from []*skill.Manifest to []{id,name,version,status,error?,manifest}. decisions.rationale: Adding the wrapper fields is forward-compatible for the current FE.
